dessin: A cropped excerpt of a printed topographic map seen from above, filling the ENTIRE image edge to edge: the pale paper color #FBFCF8 covers the whole image, no outer background color, no frame, no border, no outline around the image, no margin; the drawing is cut cleanly by the four image edges as if the map continued beyond them. Roads only: a small road network of three or four roads meeting at two junctions, each road drawn as a red line #C4472B (about 4 px) with a thin ink edge #23281F on both sides, the roads running off the image edges. No buildings, no water, no contour lines, no arrows. No text, no letters, no numbers, no contour labels, no symbols other than those described, nothing else.
